events.title: Gordon Strachan scores twice as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 아스널 4–2 at Old Trafford, the Gunners' third consecutive defeat in the space of seven days.

에버턴 go top of the league by beating 레스터 시티 3–0. Kerry Dixon scores a hat-trick as 첼시 fight back from two down to beat 코번트리 시티 6–2. A late Ronnie Whelan goal gives 리버풀 victory at 스토크 시티. In Division Three, bottom side 케임브리지 유나이티드 beat 뉴포트 카운티 2–1, their first away win in 18 months.

첼시 brush aside 월솔 in their Milk Cup third round replay, scoring three goals without reply in the first 11 minutes. A Howard Gayle goal in extra time is enough for 선덜랜드 to knock out 노팅엄 포리스트 who have 18-year-old Paul Raynor sent off.

리버풀 concede early to 벤피카 in Lisbon and have 케니 달글리시 sent off, but hang on to reach the European Cup quarter-finals on a 3–2 aggregate. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 are stunned by Partizan Belgrade in the UEFA Cup, losing on away goals following a 4–0 defeat in Yugoslavia , but 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 make it through, as do 에버턴 in the Cup Winners' Cup.

에버턴 stay top with a 1–0 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park . 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 also win away but 아스널 are held at home by 애스턴 빌라. In the Third Division, 헐 시티 come from 4–1 down to win 5–4 at Orient .

FA Cup first round day produces its usual selection of surprise results. Altrincham win 1–0 at 블랙풀 and Northwich Victoria beat 크루 알렉산드라 3–1 while seven other non-league clubs take league opposition to a replay. No such luck for Tow Law Town , beaten 7–2 at 브래드퍼드 시티 , or Penrith , thrashed 9–0 by 번리, for whom Kevin Hird and Alan Taylor both score three. In the First Division, leaders 에버턴 beat bottom club 스토크 시티 4–0 at Goodison Park.

In the Milk Cup fourth round, Second Division 그림즈비 타운 cause a shock by winning at 에버턴 through a last-minute header by Paul Wilkinson . Andy Blair scores a hat-trick of penalties in 셰필드 웬즈데이's 4–2 win over 루턴 타운. Non-league Enfield and Telford United win their FA Cup replays but Kettering Town and Bangor City are knocked out.

Kerry Dixon scores his second hat-trick of the month as 첼시 beat 맨체스터 시티 4–1 in the Milk Cup. In the FA Cup, Bognor Regis Town beat 스완지 시티 3–1 to reach the second round for the first time in their history.

선덜랜드 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–2 in a dramatic match at Roker Park . Both sides have a player sent off and Clive Walker scores a hat-trick (including two penalties) after the home side had trailed 2–0, all in the first half. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 also come from two down to beat 리즈 유나이티드 5–2 at the top of the Second Division with John Aldridge scoring three. Two goals by John Wark give 리버풀 their first league win at home for three months, against his former club 입스위치 타운. Brighton and Hove Albion score their first goal in six matches but are beaten 2–1 at home by 미들즈브러 .
FA Cup replay joy for Alliance Premier League side Dagenham who win 2–1 after extra time at 스윈던 타운 .
퀸스 파크 레인저스 and 사우샘프턴 play out a goalless Milk Cup replay at Loftus Road. Steve Moran has an 85th-minute penalty saved by 레인저스 keeper Peter Hucker .

토트넘 홋스퍼 beat Bohemians Prague 2–0 in the UEFA Cup third round but 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held 2–2 at home by 던디 유나이티드 . Gordon Strachan scores a penalty but has a second saved by fellow Scot Hamish McAlpine .
